findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcription_get_transcript · Private data: transcription_list_audio_files, transcription_start_workflow · Public sink: transcription_start_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcription_get_transcript · Private data: transcription_list_audio_files, transcription_start_workflow · Public sink: transcription_start_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
